tasks.label: Build & Run (MSVC)
tasks.command: if not exist build mkdir build && cl /nologo /EHsc /std:c++17 /MD /O2 /Iinclude /IExternal\include /I. main.cpp renderer.cpp models.cpp game.cpp menus.cpp cutscene.cpp audio.cpp src\glad.c /Fo:build\ /Fe:MetroDefenders.exe /link /LIBPATH:lib glfw3.lib opengl32.lib user32.lib gdi32.lib shell32.lib && MetroDefenders.exe

tasks.label: Build & Run (MinGW g++)
tasks.command: g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Iinclude -IExternal/include -I. main.cpp renderer.cpp models.cpp game.cpp menus.cpp cutscene.cpp audio.cpp -x c src/glad.c -x none -o MetroDefenders.exe -Llib/mingw -lglfw3 -lopengl32 -lgdi32 -luser32 -lshell32 -lole32 -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++ && MetroDefenders.exe
